paite: Huan mipite zak a athugen teng azohtak in Kapernaum ah alut a,
heading: Sepaih Zaheutu Sikha Hihdamna / (Mat 8.5-13)

paite: sepaih zaheutu kuahiam sikha deihtak a china in, asi dekdek hi.
Huchi in Jesu tanchin azaktak in asikha hong hihdam ding a ngen ding in akiang ah Juda upate asawl hi.
Amau Jesu kiang ava tung ua, limtak in angen uhi,
"Amah zaw na hihsak tak ahi; ka nam uh a-it a, ka sinagog uh leng ama hon lamsak ahi,” achi uhi.
Huchi in Jesu amau toh ahong pai hi. A-inn atun dek kuan in sepaih zaheutu'n alawmte asawl a, "Ka insung na lutna tak ahi kei,
huaiziak in na kiang a hong tak in leng ka kisim kei, thu leltak gen lechin, ka naupang adam mai ding.

Kei leng mi thunuai a om ka hi a, ka nuai ah sepaihte a-om ua; huai mipa, hiai mipa, 'Pai in,' ka chihleh apai a, midang kiang ah leng, 'Hong pai in,' ka chihleh ahong pai a; ka sikha kiang ah leng, hiai hih in, ka chih leh ahih zel," achi hi.
Jesu'n huai thu azak in lamdang asa mahmah a, akihei a, mipi amah zuite kiang ah, "K'on hilh ahi, Israelte lak ah leng hichi tel a ginna thupi ka mu kha kei," achi hi.
Huan inn ah amisawlte apai nawn ua, damtak in sikha amuta uhi.
Huan sawt louchik in khua khat Nain kichi ah ahoh a; akiang ah anungzuite leh mipi tampitak ahoh sam uhi.
heading: Meithai Tapa Hihdamna

paite: Khopi kongkhak kiang atun in, ngai in, misi ahon zawngkhia ua, anu tapa neihsun ahi a, amah lah meithai ahi ngal a; akhua mite tampi akiang ah a-om uhi.
Toupa'n meithainu amuh in, alainat mahmah a, "Kap ke'n," achi hi.
Huan ava naih a, lang ava len hi; huchi in lang zawngte akhawl uhi. "Tangval thou in, ka hon chi," achi hi.
Huan misi atukhia a, ahong pauta hi. Huchi in Jesu'n anu kiang ah apeta hi.
Huan mi tengteng in alau ua, Pathian aphat ua, "I lak ah zawlnei thupi ahong suakta, achi ua, Pathian in amite hong vehta," achi uhi.
Huan huai mi tungtang thu Judia gam tengteng leh akiang vel gam teng ah athangkheta hi.
Huan Johan nungzuite'n huai thu tengteng Johan ahilh uhi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Misawlte / (Mat 11.2-19)

paite: Huchi in Johan in anungzuite nih asam a, Toupa kiang ah asawl a, "Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, midang hungaih lailai ding ka hi uhia?” chi in.
Huan amisawlte akiang ahong tun un, "Baptispa Johan in, 'Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, midang hungaih lai ding ka hi uhia?' chi in na kiang ah kou a hon sawl," achi uhi.
Huaitak in Jesu'n, damloute, hipi veite, dawimatte tampi ahihdam a, mittaw tampite leng amit uh ahihvak hi.

Akiang uah, "Pai nawnta unla, thil na muh uleh na zak uh Johan va hilh un; mittawte mit ahong vakta, khebaite khe in apaita ua, phakte hihsiang in om ua, nangongte bil ahong vakta, misite kaihthoh in a-omta uh, azawngte'n tanchinhoih hilh atangta uh.
Huan kuapeuh ka tung a lung hihlouhna mu lou ahampha hi," chi in adawng hi.
Johan sawltakte apai nung un Jesu'n mipite kiang ah Johan thu agen a, "Bang en ding a gamdai a paikhia na hi ua? Sialluang huih mut ling maw?
Ahihkeileh, bang en ding pen a paikhia na hi ua? Puannem silh mi maw? Ngai un, puan thupi silh leh minuamsate kumpipate inn ah ei ve a-om uh.
Ahihkeileh, bang en ding pen in ahia na paikhiak uh? Zawlnei maw? Ahi tawk vo oi, ka hon chi ahi, amah zaw zawlnei sang a leng thupizaw ahi.
'En dih, ka thangkou na ma ah ka sawl ahi, ama'n na ma ah na lampi abawlkhol ding, chi a, atanchin kigelh, hiai mipa ahi.’
Numei suan lak ah Johan sang a thupizaw a-om kei; himahleh Pathian lalgam a mineupen leng amah sang in athupizaw, ka hon chi ahi," achi hi.
Huan mi tengteng leh siahkhonte'n huai azak un, Johan khut a baptisma tangsa ahih ziak un, Pathian siam atangsak uhi.
Pharisaite leh dan thei mite'n bel akiang a baptisma ana tang kei ua, amau a ding a Pathian in hoih dia asehsak adeih kei uhi.
Huchi in Jesu mah in, "Hiai khang bang toh ka teh diam aw? Bang toh kibang ahi ua?
Naupang dawr mun a tu a, 'Tamngai hon tumsak ung a, lam lou uchin a;' 'Suun ung a, nou lah kap tuan lou uchin a,' chi a kichituahte bang ahi uh.
Baptispa Johan ahong pai a, tanghou ane kei, uain leng adawn kei a nou, 'Dawi zawl ei ve,' na chi uhi.
Mihing Tapa ahong pai a, ane in adawn a, 'En dih uh, an haipa, uain haipa, siahkhon mite leh mikhialte lawm,' na chi zel uhi.
Himahleh pilna tuh atate tengteng in siam atan uhi," achi hi.
Pharisaite lak a mi khat in akiang a an ne ding in adeih hi. Huai Pharisai inn ah alut a, an a-um hi.
heading: Pharisai Simon Inn A Jesu Thaunilhna

paite: Ngai dih, huai khua a numei khat om in Pharisai inn ah an um in atu chih a theihtak in alabaster bawm in thaunamtui ahon tawi hi.
Anung ah akhepek bul ah kap kawm in adingh a, akhitui in akhepek asukawt a, asam in anul a, akhepek atawp a, thaunamtui anuh hi.
Huan asampa Pharisai in huai amuh in, alungsim in, “Hiai mi zawlnei ahihleh akhoihnu numei kua ahia, mi bangchi ahia, theihtuaktak hi a, mikhial ahi ngal a," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, na kiang ah thu kam khat gen ding ka nei," chi in adawng hi. Ama'n, "Bang ahia, Sinsakpa?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Dangka leitawisak kuahiam in leibami nih anei a; khat in makhai zanga, khat in sawmnga aba uhi.
Huan aditna ding anei kei ua, angaidam tuaktuak hi. Huai mite akua in amah a-itzaw dia?" achi hi.
Simon in, "Angaihdam tampen in hi in ka gingta," chi in adawng hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Na chi dik," achi hi.
Huan numei lam anga a, Simon kiang ah, "Hiai numei na mu hia? Na inn ah ka hong lut a, nang ka khepek silna ding tui na hon pe kei a, ama'n akhitui in ka khepek asukawt a, asam in anul hi.
Nang tawp himhim na hon tawp kei; ama'n ka hong lut nungsiah ka khepek tawp atawlnga kei hi.
Nang ka lutang ah thau na hon nilh kei a; ama'n ka khepek thaunamtui anilh hi.
Huaiziak in ka hon chi ahi, akhelhna tampi ngaihdam in a-omta; ama'n nakpi in a-it hi. Himahleh, ngaidam tawm in, neuchik in a-it," achi hi.
Huai zoh in numei kiang ah, "Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
Huchi in an umpihte'n, "Mikhialte nangawn ngaidam kua ahia eita?" akichi uhi.
Numei kiang ah, "Na ginna in ahon hondam hi, khamuangtak in paita in," achi hi.
